run: a blind pronunciation review of the A/B/C renders: which Persian words OmniVoice gets wrong, and whether diacritics or IPA input fix them
status: registered 2026-10-03, before anyone listened; the listener is the user, first
why: the user deferred the voice listening test until pronunciation is fixed. [measured] on the sealed Neyshekar set the recogniser reads the speakers' own recordings at CER 6.4% and OmniVoice's renders at 9.9%. Before fixing, the errors have to be found: this asks a native listener to mark them word by word

material.renders: eval/runs/omnivoice-ipa-ab-v3 (2026-09-24): 14 hard sentences - homographs (gol/gel, mard/mord, ruye), an ezafe chain, difficult consonants, clusters, colloquial, long, four of the sealed test texts and a corpus sentence - in the voice of the Mana-TTS reference

conditions.A: OmniVoice on plain Persian script (what the app does)
conditions.B: OmniVoice on a diacritised twin (11 sentences; none written for the 3 long ones)
conditions.C: the OmniVoice IPA fine-tune on canonical IPA from Homo-GE2PE, which read the twin where one exists

wrong_in_twins_found_before_listening.t11: بارانِ بَند آمد: no ezafe on باران (the rain stopped)
wrong_in_twins_found_before_listening.s08: حِرفا should be حَرفا; خُریدار should be خَریدار

blind: per sentence the renders take slots 1-3 in balanced orders (each condition in each slot about equally often, seed 20261004) under anonymous file names; all renders of a sentence matched to one loudness by gain; the page shows only the plain sentence, never a twin. The key is eval/runs/evidence/pronunciation-review-v1/key.json (fingerprint fdc17ebfc261c9e6)
asked_per_render: either 'every word right' or the words said wrong (tapped on the sentence's words), with an optional note of what was heard
asked_per_sentence: which render read best (or no difference)

analysis_fixed_before_listening.per_condition: renders with no marked word out of those answered; words marked wrong out of the words in those renders; times picked as reading best
analysis_fixed_before_listening.also: the same by sentence category, and every marked word with the listener's note; a mark under B or C on a sentence whose twin is wrong is listed with that note
analysis_fixed_before_listening.what_it_is_for: deciding the fix: if B or C clears what A gets wrong, the input form is the lever (diacritics or phonemes before the model); if all three fail on the same words, it is the model or the twins; the categories say which kinds of words
analysis_fixed_before_listening.not_claimed: fourteen sentences, one voice, one seed and few listeners: a diagnostic, not a measure of any system's pronunciation
